//data_dir: Base folder for all downloads. ~ is expanded. On macOS you can point this into iCloud Drive so the CSVs appear on your iPhone, e.g. ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/OuraData
//headless: true for scheduled runs. Set false with `oura-export login --headful` the first time if you want to watch the login.
//request_timeout_minutes: How long to wait for Oura to build the export before giving up.
//poll_interval_seconds: How often to re-check whether the export is ready.
//notify: Best-effort desktop notification on success/failure (macOS & Windows).
